data.narrative:
Periodic Labs is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Liam Fedus and Ekin Dogus Cubuk that has raised $300M to date. The relevant comp universe spans 16 peers in the AI & Software sector, including one public company (Palantir) and eight private peers such as Waymo, Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI.

Given the target's stage and funding history, the Stage-Progression method is applicable and forms the basis of valuation. Using total raised ($300M) as a proxy for current value and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $750M. The Peer-Median method is not applicable: while 16 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, similar-tier) yield insufficient datapoints (fewer than three), making a narrowly tailored comparable approach unreliable. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $638M (low) to $862M (high), with a median of $750M. This single-method triangulation carries material uncertainty: the absence of tightly matched peer data limits confidence in the step-up multiplier, and the company's true pre-money valuation prior to the most recent round remains unmeasured. Key variables affecting valuation stability include deployment of the $300M raised, product-market traction, and comparative burn metrics relative to the identified peer set.
